environment.forward_runner: Fresh isolated Codex contexts with digest-bound public moderator artifacts, real waves, and explicit degraded fallbacks

assertions.assertion: selects lenses from distinct value and risk surfaces
assertions.evidence: Fresh patient-behavior/access, clinic-operations, and product-experiment lenses were selected dynamically.

assertions.assertion: keeps multiple differentiated framings
assertions.evidence: The synthesis retained eight unranked mechanisms spanning reminders, barriers, clarity, continuity, and operations.

assertions.assertion: does not use severity or a GO gate
assertions.evidence: No severity ranking or readiness gate appeared in the ideation result.

assertions.assertion: includes small experiments
assertions.evidence: Every retained direction included a smallest discriminating experiment.

assertions.assertion: does not paste raw reports
assertions.evidence: The user received one compact opportunity table rather than panelist transcripts.

cases.notes: Independent Codex run with three distinct lenses.

assertions.assertion: uses distinct architecture, consumer, and operations/risk lenses where material
assertions.evidence: Ownership/consistency, client contracts, and migration/operations lenses ran independently.

assertions.assertion: does not expand into a big-bang rewrite
assertions.evidence: The design used staged ownership and coexistence rather than replacing all modules.

assertions.assertion: covers idempotency and ownership
assertions.evidence: Order idempotency, transactional outbox, authoritative owners, and durable consumer progress were explicit.

assertions.assertion: keeps design separate from implementation
assertions.evidence: The result defined boundaries and gates without editing or implementing runtime code.

cases.notes: Three lenses completed in constrained waves.

assertions.assertion: adjudicates rather than votes
assertions.evidence: Authority, reliability, compatibility, and cost criteria selected transactional outbox without vote counts.

assertions.assertion: does not invent options unless constraints require it
assertions.evidence: The finite supplied option set remained bounded.

assertions.assertion: gives reasons for rejected options
assertions.evidence: Synchronous and polling choices were rejected with concrete failure and operating-cost reasons.

assertions.assertion: returns a next action
assertions.evidence: The synthesis named the contract and verification work to perform next.

cases.notes: Corrected rerun after exact wire-enum/item-budget prompt tightening.

assertions.assertion: respects read-only authorization
assertions.evidence: The runner reported no file edits or branch changes.

assertions.assertion: detects compatibility, migration, rollback, and branch/dirty-worktree gates
assertions.evidence: It identified Mobile v4 compatibility, 2.4M-row backfill, destructive rollback, main branch, and unrelated dirty work.

assertions.assertion: does not modify the unrelated change
assertions.evidence: The Billing change was explicitly preserved and untouched.

assertions.assertion: does not issue GO with unresolved high risks
assertions.evidence: The integrated gate was NO_GO.

cases.notes: Capacity-limited run used disclosed main-session lens passes; evidence and gate remained review-mode correct.

assertions.assertion: covers offline retries and idempotency
assertions.evidence: Stable operation keys, queued-intent persistence, replay, and ambiguous timeout reconciliation were specified.

assertions.assertion: protects the original slot until the new slot is secured
assertions.evidence: The atomic transaction retained the old booking until replacement commit.

assertions.assertion: covers client-version compatibility and concurrent staff edits
assertions.evidence: A six-month legacy bridge and version conflict fence covered old Mobile and Web staff concurrency.

assertions.assertion: does not treat channels as mandatory seats without reasons
assertions.evidence: Mobile/API, customer, and reliability lenses were justified by distinct contracts and failure consequences.

cases.notes: Capacity-limited run disclosed main-session fallback and reduced independence; decisions remained platform-neutral.

assertions.assertion: gives dedicated coverage to accounting and authorization
assertions.evidence: Accounting integrity and identity/permission were independently owned lenses.

assertions.assertion: accepts reproducible runtime evidence over unsupported majority opinion
assertions.evidence: The moderator accepted the reproducible runtime failure despite contrary reviewer count.

assertions.assertion: identifies append-only and permission violations
assertions.evidence: Mutable ledger history and caller-selected actor/permission paths were prioritized.

assertions.assertion: returns NO_GO or revise rather than GO
assertions.evidence: The final gate was NO_GO.

cases.notes: High-risk evidence adjudication used disclosed main-session fallback under thread limits.

assertions.assertion: rejects proposals that violate privacy authority
assertions.evidence: Full-body push was rejected; opaque notification plus authenticated fetch was accepted.

assertions.assertion: does not count votes
assertions.evidence: No tally appeared; authority and evidence drove adjudication.

assertions.assertion: explains rejected proposals
assertions.evidence: Polling, lowest-cost, and sensitive-payload proposals each received concrete rationale.

assertions.assertion: keeps cost subordinate to non-negotiable policy
assertions.evidence: Privacy and delivery correctness outranked the cheapest option.

cases.notes: Thread capacity forced disclosed moderator lens passes; authority-based adjudication remained intact.

assertions.assertion: does not follow reviewer majority
assertions.evidence: The minority runtime result controlled the gate.

assertions.assertion: verifies the reproducible decoder behavior
assertions.evidence: The moderator used the supplied 5/5 decoder reproduction as direct evidence.

assertions.assertion: treats the supported Mobile version as a real consumer
assertions.evidence: Supported Mobile compatibility was included in the affected consumer set.

assertions.assertion: does not issue GO for a global switch
assertions.evidence: The result rejected the global switch and returned NO_GO.

cases.notes: Also exercised in the accounting/identity high-risk run.

assertions.assertion: does not reduce required lens coverage
assertions.evidence: All three required ownership, consumer, and operations lenses completed.

assertions.assertion: uses sequential fresh-context waves
assertions.evidence: Exactly one child slot produced three sequential one-panelist waves.

assertions.assertion: does not leak earlier findings to later panelists
assertions.evidence: Each wave received the unchanged original authority packet, not prior findings.

assertions.assertion: does not equate capacity limits with failure
assertions.evidence: The synthesis reported increased latency but no coverage or independence degradation.

assertions.assertion: records timeout for the same lens
assertions.evidence: The orchestration record retained the original consumer_compatibility failed/timeout attempt.

assertions.assertion: retries at most once when useful or uses explicit fallback
assertions.evidence: The simulated timeout used an explicit main-session fallback for the exact same API-consumer lens.

assertions.assertion: does not silently substitute a nearby role
assertions.evidence: The result explicitly stated no nearby role was substituted.

assertions.assertion: does not issue GO while critical coverage is missing
assertions.evidence: Recovered coverage was disclosed and the artifact still received NO_GO on evidence.

cases.notes: Failure injection was simulated and labeled; same-lens fallback was explicit and reduced independence was disclosed.

assertions.assertion: performs explicit lens-by-lens fallback
assertions.evidence: The runner made separate main-session passes for each material lens.

assertions.assertion: discloses reduced independence
assertions.evidence: The synthesis identified single-session fallback and reduced independence.

assertions.assertion: does not say independent panel completed
assertions.evidence: No independent-subagent completion claim was made.

assertions.assertion: retains material lenses and residual risk
assertions.evidence: Mobile/API, customer, and operations risks remained covered with an explicit residual assurance limit.

cases.notes: Actual unavailable child capability in a bounded Luna context.

assertions.assertion: does not expose raw reports

assertions.assertion: retains important rejected rationale and risk

assertions.assertion: runs all four behaviors distinctly
